question.text: What will India's total meat production per capita be during 2026-2027?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the total meat production per capita of India during 2026-27 as reported by [the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying](https://www.dahd.gov.in/) of the Government of India.

research:
I couldn't find any official per-capita meat figure past 2024-25, when it stood at 7.50 kg per year. The 2026-27 number this question resolves on will most likely appear in the 2027 edition of the Ministry's annual report (Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics, BAHS), probably around late November 2027. Nothing settles the question yet.

## 1. Resolution source
- The ministry website (dahd.gov.in) and the BAHS 2025 PDF both returned HTTP 403 errors, so I couldn't read them directly. The figures below come from the question text and from sites that quote the report.
- 2025-11 (released around 2025-11-26, National Milk Day): BAHS 2025 gives meat production of 10.50 million tonnes in 2024-25, up 2.46% from 10.25 million tonnes. Per capita availability was 7.50 kg per year (some sites write 7.51), up from 7.39 in 2023-24. [Vet Extension](https://www.vetextension.com/livestock-production-statistics-of-india-2025/), [Agridots](https://agridots.com/courses/exam-ibps-afo/agriculture/animal-husbandry/01-03-production-parameters), [PIB release](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2195049&reg=3&lang=2)
- Wording caveat: the ministry publishes "per capita availability of meat" (production divided by projected population). It does not publish a series called "production per capita". That availability series is presumably what the question means.
- Shares of 2024-25 production by species: poultry 49.27%, buffalo 18.42%, goat 15.06%, sheep 11.29%, pig 3.65%, cattle 2.30%. [Vet Extension](https://www.vetextension.com/livestock-production-statistics-of-india-2025/)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-11-05: Nothing settles the question. Official 2025-26 estimates (BAHS 2026) don't appear to be out yet; I found no 2025-26 figure from the Integrated Sample Survey, the ministry's seasonal livestock survey. The 2026-27 survey runs roughly March 2026 to February 2027, and its results are expected around November 2027.
- One commercial market-research page projects 10.83 million tonnes and 7.67 kg per capita for 2026. This is not an official figure. [Ken Research](https://www.kenresearch.com/industry-reports/india-meat-market)

## 3. Recent news
- 2026-11-03: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India will not open its dairy sector in trade deals or allow GM imports. This is not directly relevant to meat output. [The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/india-has-never-allowed-import-of-genetically-modified-products-will-never-open-dairy-sector-piyush-goyal/article71660272.ece)
- 2026-05/03: There were local bird flu (H5N1) outbreaks: about 4,400 chicken deaths at a farm in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, with poultry sales banned within 10 km, and a case in Ludhiana, Punjab. I found no evidence of a national-scale hit to poultry output. [eFeedLink](https://www.efeedlink.com/contents/03-30-2026/665d6324-dee9-46a1-9aa1-a26b1f553c47-0502.html), [India TV](https://www.indiatvnews.com/news/india/bird-flu-detected-ludhiana-poultry-farm-punjab-latest-news-703374)
- 2026-02: Saudi Arabia suspended poultry imports from 40 countries, including India, over bird flu. [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/topic/poultry)
- 2026-01: Kerala reported 11 H5N1 farm outbreaks in December 2025, with about 54,100 birds dead or culled. [The Poultry Site](https://www.thepoultrysite.com/news/2026/01/india-reports-11-h5n1-outbreaks-on-poultry-farms)
- 2025-12-19: Meat production rose 29% between 2018-19 (8.11 million tonnes) and 2024-25. Five states supply most of it, and Telangana has the highest per capita level at 28.8 kg. [Dataful](https://insights.dataful.in/articles/meat-production-rises-29-in-india-but-five-states-drive-most-of-the-supply)

## 4. Base rates
Official per capita availability (kg per year), from BAHS editions:
- 2018-19: 6.15 (question background)
- 2020-21: about 6.52 (worked back from 6.82 minus the 0.30 rise) [Pashudhan Praharee](https://pashudhanpraharee.com/?p=22230)
- 2021-22: 6.82 (+0.30) [eFeedLink](https://www.efeedlink.com/contents/03-20-2023/1c037fd6-0280-4bc5-8e04-93ae509847fd-a181.html)
- 2022-23: 7.10 (+0.28), with production of 9.77 million tonnes, up 5.13%. This comes from a secondary source citing BAHS 2023. [Pashudhan Praharee](https://pashudhanpraharee.com/?p=31279)
- 2023-24: 7.39 (+0.29)
- 2024-25: 7.50 (+0.11). The gain slowed sharply as production growth fell to 2.46%.

Trend:
- From 2018-19 to 2024-25, per capita availability grew about 3.4% a year on average, roughly +0.22 kg a year.
- Annual gains from 2021 to 2024 were steady at +0.28 to +0.30 kg. 2024-25 was the outlier at +0.11.
- Figures from earlier editions can be revised.

Arithmetic, not a forecast, assuming population grows about 0.9% a year:
- Two more years of 2024-25-style gains (about +0.11 each) would give about 7.72 for 2026-27.
- Two years of 2021-24-style gains (about +0.29 each) would give about 8.08.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on Indian meat output. None of the markets supplied with this task match the question; they cover US oil, broilers, corn, and Indian politics and companies.
- I found no USDA or FAO forecast in kg per capita that follows the ministry's method. The USDA's annual India livestock report, the [FAS GAIN Livestock and Products Annual](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Livestock+and+Products+Annual_New+Delhi_India_IN2025-0048.pdf), covers buffalo meat (carabeef) only. The 7.67 kg figure for 2026 from Ken Research is a commercial projection.

## 6. Upcoming events
- Around 2026-11-26 (National Milk Day): BAHS 2026, with 2025-26 estimates, is likely to be released. It is the key indicator for the trend and may also revise the 2024-25 figure.
- 2026-27 survey seasons: summer (March to June 2026), rainy (July to October 2026), winter (November 2026 to February 2027).
- February 2027: the Census 2027 population count. It could eventually change the population figure the per capita number is divided by, though it probably won't be used in time for the 2026-27 figure.
- Ongoing: bird flu outbreaks (poultry is about half of output) and feed costs. Maize prices could rise now that ethanol made from FCI rice is capped and demand shifts to maize (reported 2026-11-04). [Tribune](https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/business/centre-caps-ethanol-made-from-surplus-fci-rice-damaged-food-grains/)
- Around 2027-11-26: BAHS 2027 is likely to be released with the 2026-27 figure that resolves this question.

I couldn't open DAHD, PIB or the USDA report directly, so the figures below come from secondary coverage of them. Writing up the results now.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the meat figure in DAHD's Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics (BAHS). The 2026-27 number should appear in **BAHS 2027**, likely around late November 2027. It will be based on the Integrated Sample Survey for roughly March 2026 to February 2027, the same pattern as earlier surveys (inferred).
- 2025-11-26: BAHS 2025 was released on National Milk Day. It drew on the March 2024 to February 2025 survey. [PIB](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2195049&reg=3&lang=2)
- Latest official value: 2024-25 meat production was 10.50 million tonnes (MT), up 2.46%. Per capita availability was **7.50 kg/year**; one secondary source says 7.51. Poultry was about 5.18 MT, roughly half of the total. [Testbook/agridots summaries](https://agridots.com/courses/exam-ibps-afo/agriculture/animal-husbandry/01-03-production-parameters), [Vet Extension](https://www.vetextension.com/livestock-production-statistics-of-india-2025/)
- The DAHD statistics page and the BAHS PDFs returned HTTP 403 when I tried to fetch them. I could not check the tables myself.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The 2026-27 survey year is still running.
- BAHS 2026, with the 2025-26 figure, is not out. I found no official 2025-26 meat estimate. It is likely due around 2026-11-26, National Milk Day.

## 3. Recent news
- 2026 (date unclear): USDA FAS's India semi-annual report puts calendar-2026 carabeef (buffalo meat) output at about 4.73 MMT carcass weight equivalent. This is a USDA projection, not DAHD data, and I could not decode the PDF to check it. [USDA FAS](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Livestock+and+Products+Semi-annual_New+Delhi_India_IN2026-0009.pdf)
- 2026: Buffalo meat exports for 2025-26 reportedly rose 25.6% to US$5.1 billion. That is a trade value, not a production figure, and I did not verify it.
- 2026-11-04: A Climate Trends report says heat stress is causing losses in India's food supply. It is not specific to meat. [News18](https://www.news18.com/agency-feeds/climate-change-already-cutting-into-indias-food-supply-report-10413024.html)
- None of the other articles the news API collected bear directly on Indian meat output.

## 4. Base rates
DAHD per capita meat availability, kg/year:
- 2018-19: 6.15 (BAHS 2025, quoted in the question)
- 2020-21: about 6.52. This is implied from "+0.30 kg" in 2021-22, not a published number.
- 2021-22: 6.82. [Deccan Herald](https://deccanherald.com/business/business-news/indias-milk-production-rises-5-to-22106-million-tn-in-fy22-1200541.html), [eFeedLink](https://www.efeedlink.com/contents/03-20-2023/1c037fd6-0280-4bc5-8e04-93ae509847fd-a181.html)
- 2022-23: 7.10, which is +0.28. [Pashudhan Praharee](https://pashudhanpraharee.com/?p=31279)
- 2023-24: 7.39, which is +0.29. Production was 10.25 MT, up 4.95%. [Drishti IAS](https://www.drishtiias.com/daily-updates/daily-news-analysis/basic-animal-husbandry-statistics-2024); 7.39 itself comes from secondary summaries.
- 2024-25: 7.50, which is +0.11. Production was 10.50 MT, up 2.46%.

What the series shows:
- Per capita availability has risen every year since 2018-19, by about 0.29 kg/year on average from 2018-19 to 2023-24. Growth slowed sharply in 2024-25.
- The population behind these figures, worked out as production divided by per capita, is about 1.376 billion (2022-23), 1.387 billion (2023-24) and 1.400 billion (2024-25). That is roughly 0.9% growth a year.

Simple extrapolations to 2026-27 (my arithmetic, not forecasts):
- +0.11 kg/year gives about 7.72.
- Production growth of 2.46%/year with about 0.9% population growth gives about 7.73.
- +0.29 kg/year gives about 8.08.
- Production growth of about 5%/year gives about 8.1.

Revisions: DAHD sometimes revises earlier years in later editions, which explains small gaps between sources (for example 7.50 vs 7.51).

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no prediction market or expert forecast on India's per capita meat figure.
- None of the Kalshi or Polymarket markets provided match this question. They cover US oil, broilers, corn, ethanol, Tesla, India-China and Indian company valuations.
- USDA FAS forecasts exist for carabeef and poultry, but they use calendar years and a different method from DAHD.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About 2026-11-26: BAHS 2026 should be released with the 2025-26 figure. This is the key signal: it will show whether the slowdown to +0.11 in 2024-25 continued or reversed.
- 2027 (spring, around Parliament sessions): DAHD answers to parliamentary questions or interim survey results may give partial-year estimates.
- Through February 2027: outbreaks of avian influenza or lumpy skin disease, feed (maize) prices, and the new caps on rice-based ethanol pushing ethanol demand onto maize could all affect poultry output. Poultry is about half of production. [Tribune](https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/business/centre-caps-ethanol-made-from-surplus-fci-rice-damaged-food-grains/)
- Mid-2027: USDA FAS's India Livestock and Products reports.
- About 2027-11-26: BAHS 2027 is released with the 2026-27 value that resolves the question.

Sources: the links in each bullet above, plus [PWOnlyIAS](https://pwonlyias.com/current-affairs/basic-animal-husbandry-statistics-2025/), [Dataful](https://dataful.in/datasets/19182/), [Factly](https://factly.in/meat-production-rises-29-in-india-but-five-states-drive-most-of-the-supply/) and [GKToday](https://www.gktoday.in/basic-animal-husbandry-statistics-2024-released/).

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) Time left: the 2026-27 figure should appear in BAHS 2027, around late November 2027, about 12 to 13 months from now. BAHS 2026, with the 2025-26 estimate, is due around 26 November 2026.

(b) Latest known value: 7.50 kg per capita per year for 2024-25, from BAHS 2025 (released November 2025). Production was 10.50 million tonnes, up 2.46%.

(c) If nothing changed, the figure would stay at about 7.50. Flat production would actually push it slightly lower, to about 7.36, because population grows about 0.9% a year.

(d) If the trend continued:
- The 2018-19 to 2024-25 average gain of about +0.22 kg a year gives roughly 7.94.
- Repeating the 2024-25 pace of +0.11 a year gives about 7.72.
- The 2021-24 pace of +0.29 a year gives about 8.08.

On the production side, 3.5% annual growth with 0.9% population growth gives about 7.89. Production growth of 2.5% gives about 7.74, and 5% gives about 8.13.

(e) Historical variation: annual changes have ranged from +0.11 to +0.30 kg. Over two years that means roughly +0.22 to +0.60 kg. Revisions to earlier figures and changes in the population projection used as the divisor add noise of about ±0.1.

(f) Experts and markets: there are no prediction markets on this. A commercial projection from Ken Research puts 2026 at 7.67 kg, which is unofficial. The question creator's bounds are 7.0 to 8.5.

(g) Unexpected scenarios:
- Low: a severe nationwide bird flu wave in 2026-27 cuts poultry output, which is about half of all meat. Combined with maize-driven feed cost spikes, this could leave production flat or falling, giving about 7.3 to 7.5.
- High: poultry growth rebounds to 6 to 8%. The ministry also switches to a lower population projection, possibly using early Census 2027 counts, which shrinks the divisor. Together these could give about 8.3 to 8.5.

(f) **Experts and markets:** There are no prediction markets on this. One commercial projection (Ken Research) gives 7.67 kg for 2026, which roughly matches a 2025-26 figure about 0.15 to 0.2 above 7.50. There is no official forecast.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** A severe nationwide bird flu wave hits in 2026-27 (poultry is about 49% of output). Combined with high maize feed costs, production could stagnate or fall, or a methodology or population-base revision (Census 2027 counts) could cut per capita availability to around 7.4 to 7.5.
- **High:** Poultry and buffalo output grow strongly (5 to 6% a year), possibly with the 2024-25 figure revised upward, pushing 2026-27 to about 8.3 to 8.5.

**Distribution:** I center the median near 7.86, a blend of the slower recent pace and the longer-run trend. I set the tails from the scenarios above: 7.4 for a production stall plus a downward revision, and 8.45 for strong growth plus an upward revision.
